decision.question: Is the image as a whole clearly rendered as a pencil drawing, with its visual content represented throughout in a pencil-drawn style?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the image as a whole is clearly and pervasively rendered in a pencil-drawing style, with visible drawn linework and shading representing the scene rather than merely muted color, grain, or isolated sketch-like areas. Fail if it remains substantially photographic or shows only partial/ambiguous pencil-like stylization. Unknown if the visual evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether the whole image has been transformed.
decision.binding: Compare the supplied source image with the edited image and assess the visible rendering of the scene as a whole against the requested pencil-drawing transformation; do not treat monochrome, grain, or isolated sketch-like shading alone as sufficient.
